A '''pilot''' competed in [[Podracing/Legends|Podraces]] for [[Team Watto]], a Podracing team, during the final [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot's]] tenure, they had made friends with fellow pilot [[Clegg Holdfast/Legends|Clegg Holdfast]]. With guidance from the crew chief, the [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarian]] [[Watto/Legends|Watto]], the pilot was able to secure a victory in the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The pilot first appeared in the [[2012]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Kinect Star Wars]]''. Their appearance and name could be determined by the player, based on a number of presets. Because of this, the pilot is never actually mentioned by name in dialogue, and is never seen during cutscenes in between gameplay.
